Frequently Asked Questions
What is a Social Set?
A Social Set includes one of each profile we support: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube, Threads and Snapchat. It helps you organize your content by brand or client.
What is an Access Group?
Access Groups make it easy to manage who can access media libraries, social profiles, and calendars within Later Social. They are especially helpful for teams and agencies working across multiple brands or clients.
Can I auto publish posts?
Yes! Auto Publish works for Instagram (business + creator accounts), Facebook, TikTok (business account), LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads and Snapchat.
We offer notification publishing for Instagram and TikTok. If you choose this option you'll get a push notification when it's time to post. Tap the alert, and your content will open in Instagram or TikTok so you can publish it manually and add things like music and stickers.
How does post count work?
Your post count is the number of scheduled posts you can create per month per social profile — not per Social Set. That includes all types of content, like Reels, Stories, and carousels. Posts count when they’re scheduled — not when they’re published.
For example, on the Starter plan, you get 30 posts per profile per month. If you have 1 Instagram and 1 TikTok account, that’s 30 posts for each — 60 total.
What kind of analytics do I get with my plan?
All Later plans come with access to powerful analytics tools. The only difference? How far back you can look.
Starter : View performance data from the last 3 months to spot quick wins and track recent results
Growth : Access up to 1 year of data to uncover trends, measure long-term performance, and plan ahead
Scale : Up to 2 years of data and custom analytics with flexible filters, cross-platform views, and shareable reports
What is Later’s future insights feature?
Future insights helps you stay ahead of the curve by showing you what’s about to trend in your industry. Powered by social listening, it analyzes emerging conversations and hashtags so you can create content that’s timely, relevant, and more likely to perform.
Available on the Scale plan.
What is Later’s competitive benchmarking feature?
Competitive benchmarking helps you see how your Instagram strategy stacks up. Build custom competitor lists and track follower growth, engagement, and posting trends — so you can uncover gaps, find opportunities, and stay one step ahead.
Available on the Scale plan.
What is Link in Bio by Later?
Later Link in Bio is a mini website, built right into your Instagram or TikTok profile, that helps turn followers into customers. You can link to products, blog posts, videos, or any content you want - all from one link in your bio.
Create a page that matches your brand, schedule posts that automatically update your Link in Bio, and track clicks to see what's working.
How many users come with a plan, and what can I do with multiple users?
Later is perfect for managing social profiles with other people, whether it's having managers approving content, team members publishing posts, or contributors submitting media. Each plan comes with a set number of users. You can add additional users to each paid plan for $5 per additional user. Note: Starter plans are limited to 1 user.
How do the annual plans work?
Save 25% when you choose an annual subscription instead of a monthly subscription. Annual plans are billed once per year and renewed automatically.
Do you have any non-profit pricing?
Yes, qualified non-profit organizations can receive 50% off our annual Growth plan. Learn more.

Frequently asked questions.
Who qualifies to join?
Anyone with an active social media presence can join Later and start earning through affiliate sales. For brand campaigns, we typically work with creators who have 5,000+ engaged followers.
How do I get paid?
Later affiliate commissions are paid monthly via direct deposit or PayPal. Campaign payments are negotiated per project and paid upon completion and approval of deliverables.
Can I do both campaigns and affiliate?
Absolutely! Many of our most successful creators combine both earning paths. Affiliate gives you consistent passive income, while campaigns provide larger one-time payments.
What platforms do you support?
You can share Later links on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, and your blog or website. Brand campaigns typically focus on Instagram and TikTok content.
Is there a cost to join?
No! Joining Later and applying for campaigns is completely free. There are no subscription fees or hidden costs—you simply earn commission on sales and get paid for campaign content.

Introduction
At Later we are committed to the legal processing, confidentiality, and security of all personal information that we handle in connection with the provision of our social media and marketing technology and services, in accordance with all applicable laws and as described in this Privacy Notice (“Notice”).
This Notice describes the personal information that we collect, how that information is processed, and your rights and choices in relation to it.
This Notice applies where we are the entity that decides on the purposes of processing of personal information and the ways in which it is processed within our products and services, also referred to as the “data controller” or “business”. In some circumstances we may process personal information on behalf of our customers and on their instructions (e.g., where we measure and analyze end users’ interactions with their posts and campaigns). There, we act only as a “data processor”, “service provider”, or “contractor”, and, while we will assist as far as we reasonably can, you should submit any questions and requests to the customer in question, as the relevant data controller or business.
Later may change this Notice from time to time, due to changes in our business, technology, applicable laws, or any other reason. Please check this page from time to time to be informed of the latest changes.
Who We Are
The “data controller” or “business” in relation to the processing of the personal information as described in this Notice is: Mavrck LLC d.b.a. Later.
Later’s social media and marketing technology and services are provided by Mavrck LLC d.b.a. Later (operating Later Influence and Later Social Enterprise), and/or through our group companies such as MyFavoriteThings, Inc. d.b.a. Mavely (affiliate marketing services for influencers), and Victory Square Media, Inc. (Later Social and Link in Bio). In this Notice, any and all of these Later group entities are collectively referred to as “we” or “Later”.
We do not sell or share mobile numbers, SMS consent, or message data with third parties or affiliates for their marketing or promotional purposes. We may share this information only with service providers (e.g., carriers, messaging platforms) to operate our SMS program. Message frequency may vary. Message & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out; for help, visit https://help-creator.later.com/ .
For any question or request relating to processing of personal information, we can be contacted as set out in Section 9.
Categories of Data, Sources of Data, Purposes of the Processing, and Legal Bases for the Processing
Later is a provider of social media and influencer marketing technology and services. Most personal information we process relates to individuals acting in the context of their trade or profession, e.g., creators and influencers on social media (“Creators”) active in a professional capacity, and staff of our brand and agency customers. Some users of our services may be consumers, e.g., non-professional Creators who use Mavely services to earn commissions.
Our principal services currently comprise the following:
Managed Campaign Services – we manage Creator marketing campaigns for brand customers, including strategy, Creator sourcing, content production, and performance reporting.
The Later Platform – we provide a self-serve Creator marketing platform that enables our customers to independently manage campaigns, communicate with Creators, and access the Later Influencer Index (Creator database).
Later Creator Program – we manage this program to enable individual Creators to join our Creator network to be discovered and matched with brand campaigns.
Later Social – we provide a SaaS social media management tool for social media managers, agencies, and brands that enables scheduling, publishing, analytics, and content management across major social platforms, including our linkin.bio tools.
Later for Creator ( formerly Mavely )– we provide an affiliate marketing platform that allows brands to run performance-based affiliate campaigns, and Creators to generate shoppable SmartLinks for products from participating brands and earn commissions on resulting sales.
In order to provide our services and manage our business, we collect and/or process personal information relating to: (1) Creators; (2) our customers and potential customers; (3) visitors to our websites and social media channels, and users of our mobile applications; and (4) our other business partners. Our services and tools enable our customers to review our Creator databases, but Later does not sell personal information and is not a data broker.
In accordance with applicable laws, we may freely process and share anonymized, aggregated, or de-identified information that does not identify you or your household.

For the performance of our contracts with our individual partners and suppliers

This information relates to your business life and business data and so has minimal privacy impact
Recipients and International Transfers of Personal information
We may disclose personal information to the following categories of third parties:
Our group companies involved with the provision of our products and services;
Our customers as part of our services;
Social media platforms, in order to provide integrations and features you request;
In the event of merger, reorganization, reincorporation, recapitalization, acquisition, or any form of sale of some or all of our assets, personal information held by us may be shared with the buyer.
Other organizations that provide services in support of our services and business such as:
providers of IT-related services (e.g., cloud hosting and storage, database management, search engine, CRM services, business tools, ID and authentication, IT infrastructure and management, trouble ticketing, customer support and communications);
data analytics and reporting providers;
security, fraud prevention, and risk auditing services;
website development, hosting, management, and maintenance providers;
AI and machine learning providers (but we do not use AI to take decisions with legal or other significant impacts and never allow third party AI systems to use personal information for training models or algorithms – please see separate Section below);
advertising, marketing, and communications service providers (e.g., email and lead management, customer satisfaction surveys); or
tax processing, accounting, legal, insurance, or payment service providers;
These organizations process personal information and other data on Later's behalf, but our contracts with them oblige them to meet data protection standards as strict as those that apply to us, and not to use your personal information for any other purpose.
We store personal information in the USA. Your personal information may also be processed on our behalf in any country where we operate or have engaged data processors, e.g., for data hosting or analysis.
Where such disclosures result in a transfer of personal information to places outside the EU/EEA, the UK, Switzerland, or other countries that are officially regarded by EU or UK authorities as having adequate data protection laws, then this will be done only on the basis of legal safeguards aimed at ensuring that your data is kept as secure as under applicable laws. These may include the standard contractual clauses for data exports as issued by the European Commission or another supervisory authority. A copy of such safeguards may be available from us if we receive a valid request.
If Later receives a request for personal information from a government, national security, or law enforcement agency, or other regulator, we would normally comply with such request without notifying affected individuals.
AI and Machine Learning
We may use your content, engagement data, and platform interactions to train and improve our AI models, including for content analysis, trend prediction, and service enhancement. This includes analyzing text, images, and video content you upload or link to our platforms. We use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies ("AI") to:
Analyze content performance and recommend optimal posting strategies;
Match influencers with relevant brand campaigns based on audience demographics and engagement patterns;
Detect fraudulent activity and fake engagement metrics;
Personalize platform experiences and suggest relevant features;
Suggest captions for your scheduled posts;
Recommend trending topics; or
Optimize campaign performance.
Automated Decision-Making: Some of our AI systems may make automated decisions, such as campaign eligibility, or content recommendations, however, such decisions do not produce legal or other significant effects, as defined by applicable laws.
Storage Period
We only retain personal information for as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected.
We may retain data for at least the time that you or your organization has an account, agreement, or other relationship with us. If you have subscribed for an account with us, or to receive a newsletter or other information, we will keep your details until you unsubscribe.
If you unsubscribe or ask for your personal information to be deleted, then we may retain some data with a view to preventing it from being collected or processed again. If we have excluded you from any of our services for any reason (e.g., breach of our terms of service), then we may also retain data in order to prevent repeated signups. We will also keep records of requests that we receive for exercise of individual rights under applicable privacy laws for the legally required period or in line with our recordkeeping policies.
We keep data relating to Creator, customer, or supplier contracts for at least the applicable limitation period for bringing legal claims, in order to be in a position to resolve any such claims. We may also keep data for longer periods where required for accounting, tax or legal reasons (in which case data use will be limited to such purposes).
We may retain and use anonymized, aggregated, or de-identified data indefinitely for analytics, research, and business purposes, including creation, development, and improvement of our products, algorithms, and models, provided that such data does not identify any individual or customer.
Your Rights
Depending on your location and the privacy laws that apply to you, you may have all or some of the following rights under those laws:
To access your personal information;
To have your personal information corrected or updated;
To object to processing of your personal information for direct marketing or for certain other purposes;
To restrict our processing of your personal information in certain circumstances;
To receive notice of what categories of personal information will be collected and the purposes for which it will be used;
To receive confirmation of whether or not your personal is being processed, plus information on how it is used, sold or shared;
To receive a copy in a portable format for transmission to another organization;
To opt out of sales or sharing, and in some states to opt out of data processing for targeted advertising and/or profiling for significant purposes;
To request deletion of your personal information ("the right to be forgotten") (subject to some exceptions e.g. where required for detecting security incidents, exercising free speech, protecting or defending against legal claims, or for internal uses reasonably aligned with consumers' expectations);
To limit use of sensitive information to necessary uses;
To request human review and receive explanations of certain specific automated decisions; and
Not to be discriminated against based upon your exercise of any of your legal rights relating to your personal information.
If our data processing is based on your consent, then you can always withdraw that consent (but any processing that took place before withdrawal will still be legal).
As a subscriber or customer of one or more of our products and services, a Creator whose details we have obtained from public sources or third party data providers, or in general a potential customer who we believe may be interested in our products and services, we may send you marketing communications in respect of any Later product and service. We will do this only in accordance with applicable laws, any consents that may be required, and this Notice. You can decline such communications at any time by contacting us as set out in Section 9 below or as explained in each communication.
If your information is visible through our services because it is legally and publicly available (e.g., on social media platforms), then such information is normally excluded from the scope of most US state privacy laws and these rights may not apply to you in relation to such data. Please contact us as set out below in case of any doubt.
If you wish to exercise any of the above legal rights, you (or your authorized agent) can write to us using the contact details in Section 9 below, and we will respond within 45 days or as required by applicable laws. If you make such a request, including through an authorized agent, we reserve the right to verify your identity and the agent's authorization. However, we may not be able to respond to your request if it is not permitted or foreseen under applicable laws. If you believe that we or any customer have not respected your rights, then you also have a right to make a complaint to the data protection supervisory authority in your country.
If we refuse a request to exercise your rights, then you are entitled to an internal appeal. You can exercise this right by contacting us, indicating the decision you wish to appeal and the reasons for the appeal. The decision will then be reviewed by one or more of our executives or legal counsel (who were not involved in making the original decision) and we will inform you of the result of the review.
Our products and services are not intended for children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from or about children. If you believe that we might have any information from or about a child, please contact us as indicated below.
Additional Information for California Residents
To supplement the details provided in Sections 3 and 4 of this Notice, we inform you that, during the 12 months before the publication of this Notice, Later collected:

Inferences drawn from any of the information identified above to create a profile about a consumer reflecting the consumer's preferences, characteristics, psychological trends, predispositions, behavior, attitudes, intelligence, abilities, and aptitudes.
These categories of information were disclosed to our providers of IT-related services (e.g., data storage, websites development, hosting, management, maintenance, or analytics services), and/or marketing, advertising, and communications services, for our business purposes, as referred to in Section 3.

Cookies Policy
A cookie is a small piece of data sent from a website or application and stored in a user's web browser. Every time the user loads the website or application, the browser sends cookie information back to the server to notify the websites that it recognizes the user.
You can find more information about different types of cookies here .
Use of cookies helps us to improve our products and services and our websites and applications and to deliver a better and more personalized service by enabling us to:
Measure numbers of visitors and usage patterns;
Monitor whether our services are working correctly;
Store information about your preferences; and
Recognize you when you use the services or our websites or applications.
You may refuse to accept cookies by activating the appropriate setting on your device. You can also remove cookies from your web browser by following the directions provided in your browser's "help" section. Some cookies are essential for securing access to and using features of our products and services or websites or applications, so if you clear all cookies then those features may not work as expected or at all, or you may need to accept some cookies on your next visit.
